method: Built forward-edge graph (DISTINCT source_chapter -> unnest(redirects_to_chapter)) from chapter_exclusions (1531 rows). Identified asymmetric pairs (X->Y exists, Y->X missing). Applied judgement-heavy filtering per A1b brief: keep only process-state boundaries with clean WCO Explanatory-Note basis; reject material-to-article one-direction rules, Section XV base-metal broadcasts, Section XI textile-product broadcasts, definitional-restriction rules, and one-directional-by-authority rules (e.g., Section XVII parts -> Section XVI machinery). Cross-checked candidate-Y chapter_notes JSON files at backend/data/extracted/ to ensure no equivalent rule already exists in different wording.

self_spot_check.wco_basis: WCO HSE General Note to Chapter 09 (Section II, Vegetable Products): 'The Chapter does not cover... (e) preparations consisting of extracts, essences, concentrates of coffee, tea or mate (heading 21.01)'. Direct sister-evidence: Chapter 13 Note 1(c) in this DB row already excludes 'extracts of coffee, tea or mate' -> 2101 with identical phrasing. The pair Ch.09 <-> Ch.21 IS bidirectional at chapter level (mixed condiments -> 2103 forward exists from Ch.09), but the specific exclusion for heading 2101 (extracts) is absent from Ch.09 even though the WCO HSE General Note explicitly states it. This closes spike case 2 (freeze-dried instant coffee): Triage routing to Ch.09 must see the 'extracts/concentrates/freeze-dried -> 2101' edge to push back to Ch.21.
self_spot_check.judgement: HIGH CONFIDENCE. Process-state boundary. Identical-wording sister-evidence exists in Ch.13 Note 1(c). WCO HSE General Note text is canonical source.

PF8 uniqueness key tuple differs from the existing 1604/caviar row by source_note_number and excluded_product_text, so no collision.
self_spot_check.judgement: HIGH CONFIDENCE. Process-state boundary. The existing Note 1(d) is too narrow (only caviar) - the WCO HSE excludes ALL fish preparations of Ch.16, including canned tuna, fish sauce, smoked-and-canned salmon, etc. Spike-trace relevance: any classification of 'canned sardines', 'fish fingers', 'fish balls' starting in Ch.03 must see pushback to Ch.16 (heading 1604/1605).

notes_for_coordinator: Quality-first: 5 high-confidence reciprocals proposed (well below the 15-30 target ceiling). All five are process-state boundaries with canonical WCO HSE General Note basis AND sister-evidence (an identical-shape rule already exists somewhere in the DB or in another chapter's notes).

Discovered 'missing-both' gaps OUT OF A1b SCOPE that the coordinator should know about: Ch.10 <-> Ch.11 (cereal grains <-> milling products) has ZERO rules in DB despite Ch.10 Note 1(b) and Ch.11 Note 2 defining the boundary - the extracted rule has redirects_to_chapter=null. Similarly, Ch.41 has zero forward edges. These would be A1c-style data-completion tasks, not A1b.

Edge-graph caveat: the 485-pair asymmetric list is dominated by Section XI textile broadcasts (Ch.50-63 forwarding to many chapters) and Section XV base-metal broadcasts (Ch.72-83). I treated these as systematic non-reciprocal patterns rather than evaluating each individually. If the coordinator wants me to evaluate any specific textile/base-metal pair, I can do so on follow-up.

I used 'A1b-reciprocal-of-<X>-<X-note-number>' as the source_note_number convention per the brief. This makes the audit trail explicit: each proposed rule cites the WCO/HSE-General-Note + the chapter-pair reciprocal it mirrors. None of the five reciprocals have an exact corresponding note in the destination chapter's PDF (I verified by reading Ch.09 chapter-09.json and Ch.07 chapter-07.json directly).

PF8 dedupe check performed via execute_sql: only the existing Ch.03 caviar -> 1604 (Note 1(d)) row hit any of the proposed insert tuples. That row's source_note_number ('Note 1(d)') and excluded_product_text ('caviar or caviar substitutes...') differ from my proposed Ch.03 -> Ch.16 rule (broader text + 'A1b-reciprocal-of-Ch16-Note-1' source_note_number), so no UNIQUE constraint collision.

UNCERTAINTY FLAGS: (1) The five proposed rules use 'A1b-reciprocal-of-...' as source_note_number. If coordinator's spec reviewer prefers a different convention (e.g., 'WCO HSE General Note'), happy to revise. (2) For rule #5 (Ch.03 -> Ch.16), the existing narrow caviar rule could arguably be 'updated' rather than supplemented by an additional broader rule. I chose to add a complementary row because (a) the existing row's source_note_number 'Note 1(d)' is the verbatim PDF source and shouldn't be mutated, (b) PF8 uniqueness allows the additional row.

Spike-case-2 coverage: rule #1 (Ch.09 -> 2101) directly addresses the freeze-dried instant coffee case from the architecture spike. The other four rules are not specifically spike-traced but are systematic boundary fixes that any reasonable freezedried/preserved/preparation case would benefit from.
